name: Tool Tidy
storyline:
You Had One Job
Uncle Vic has gone off to the car show, and he finally left you in charge of the shop!
That’s right, you. In charge.
Of the whoooole shop.

Everything was going great. Then some local thugs showed up… demanding "protection money."
You refused, of course. Boldly.
Heroically?

Anyway, they wrecked the place.

So, now you have to tidy everything up before Uncle Vic gets back. Because if he finds out, he will Never leave you in charge again.

*whispers* Ever.

Everything has its place
Paint lids go on paint cans. Paint cans go in boxes. Boxes go on shelves. It’s very simple.
Nest smaller items inside bigger ones and build up a perfectly organised garage, layer by satisfying layer.
Order... must be restored.

One-of-a-kind items
It’s not all spanners and screwdrivers. The shop is packed with quirky, unique items, and every single one has its proper spot.
You will find that spot.
Also, the goons messed up the car. Why the car? Nobody knows.
Pop its doors and wheels back on before the owner comes to collect it, and act natural.

Coffee! It gives you some ideas!
Stuck on where something goes? Coffee.
A quick coffee break gives you a nudge in the right direction.
Coffee makes everything better. More coffee makes everything... More.
Know your limits.

Find hidden keepsakes
Little keepsakes and treasures are hiding in all this chaos. Keep your eyes open while you tidy.
What will you discover? Only you can find out!
That's how finding works.

Spot the 80s and 90s references
Nods to 80s and 90s pop culture are hidden all around the shop. How many can you find?
Count them. Out loud.
Hopefully more than four…

Uncle Vic is counting on you!
He just doesn’t know that yet…
summary: A cosy, first person, tidying game set in a wrecked mechanic's shop. Put every tool, tub, bottle, can and part back where it belongs before opening time, and before Uncle Vic gets back!
